/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p=Path('tool/tsh/tsh.go')
s=p.read_text()
handlers=['onPlay','onLogin','onLogout','onListNodes','onListClusters','onSSH','onBenchmark','onJoin','onSCP','refuseArgs','onShow','onStatus','onApps','onEnvironment']
for name in handlers:
    pattern=r'(?m)"'^func '"'+name+r'\\((["'^'"\\n]*)\\) \\{'
    s,n=re.subn(pattern,lambda m:'func '+name+'('+m.group(1)+') error {',s,count=1)
    assert n==1,name
    start=re.search(r'(?m)"'^func '"'+name+r'\\(',s).start()
    next_func=re.search(r'(?m)"'^func '"',s[start+5:])
    end=start+5+next_func.start() if next_func else len(s)
    body=s[start:end]
    body=re.sub(r'(?m)"'^([ '"\\t]*)utils\\.FatalError\\((.*)\\)"'$'"',r'\\1return \\2',body)
    # Bare returns in these top-level handlers mean success.
    body=re.sub(r'(?m)"'^([ '"\\t]*)return"'$'"',r'\\1return nil',body)
    # Every handler needs successful completion.
    match=re.search(r'\\n\\}\\n',body)
    assert match,name
    body=body[:match.start()]+'\\n\\treturn nil'+body[match.start():]
    s=s[:start]+body+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
PY

Updated [tsh.go](/app/tool/tsh/tsh.go) so `Run` returns errors, applies runtime options after parsing, and passes `mockSSOLogin` into the client config. `main` now handles the returned error with `utils.FatalError`; handlers defined in `tsh.go` return errors instead of exiting. Added focused tests in [tsh_test.go](/app/tool/tsh/tsh_test.go).

`gofmt` and `git diff --check` pass. The tsh test run is blocked at compilation until the coordinator adds `client.SSOLoginFunc` and `client.Config.MockSSOLogin`. The database handlers in `tool/tsh/db.go` still need conversion and `Run` dispatch updates; that file is outside my assigned edit scope. I recorded both dependencies in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
